name: Crimson Breath

source.title: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

text:
Frequency once per day

---
You gain a fire breath weapon similar to that of a crimson worm. You breathe a blast of flame in a 30-foot cone that deals (ceil(max(0,((@actor.level - 13/2)))*2)+12)d6 fire damage to all creatures in the area (basic Reflex save save). This damage increases by 2d6 at 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

---
Note: A DC was not provided for this ability by Paizo. The button above uses the better of your class or spell DC.
